[PROJECT DIRECTION: High-end Beauty Editorial Collage]

[PROJECT SPECIFICATIONS]
- Format: 2x2 Grid Collage with 4:5 aspect ratio
- Aesthetic Style: Ultra-luxury, high-end beauty editorial with a modern, artistic edge
- Technical Requirements:
  - Rendering Engine: Blender or equivalent, utilizing Cycles render for ultra-realism
  - Realism Level: Ultra-photorealistic with no visible aliasing or artifacts
  - Texture Quality: High-resolution 8k textures for all assets
  - Lighting Simulation: Ray-traced studio lighting with real-world lighting rig
  - Output Resolution: 8192x10872 pixels (4096x5120 per panel)

[GLOBAL ASSET SPECIFICATIONS]
- Subject Definition:
  - Hair: Long, loosely wavy, voluminous with natural texture and individual strand definition
  - Hair Behavior: Messy yet styled, framing the face and cascading over shoulders
  - Complexion: Porous, hyper-realistic skin texture with a dewy, glass-skin finish
  - Makeup: Heavy flush/blush on cheeks, high-gloss natural pink lips, clean lashes, and defined brows
  - Wardrobe:
    - Item: Mini dress with spaghetti straps and mid-thigh length
    - Fit: Bodycon / Tight, hugging the body
    - Fabric: Soft textured knit/boucle with fuzzy, light-catching fibers
    - Color: Soft mauve or neutral taupe, matching skin undertones
  - Environment:
    - Studio Setup: Seamless paper background in soft off-white/beige
    - Atmosphere: Clean, warm, and intimate with minimal distractions
    - Lighting Rig: Large diffuse softbox (Front-Left) as key light, reflector (Right) as fill light
    - Highlights: Specular highlights on lips, cheekbones, and shoulders

[PANEL ARCHITECTURE AND DIRECTION]

[PANEL 1: Top-Left (1) - Extreme Close-Up (Macro)]
- Shot Type: Extreme Close-Up (Macro) focusing on face
- Composition:
  - Angle: Low angle, looking up slightly
  - Focus: Mouth and nose area with shallow depth of field
  - Framing: Cropped to show only the face and upper chest
- Action:
  - Primary Action: Eating a strawberry with delicate finger hold
  - Secondary Action: Lips slightly parted, tongue visible
  - Mood: Sensual, intimate, and slightly vulnerable

[PANEL 2: Top-Right (2) - Medium Shot (Thigh-up)]
- Shot Type: Medium Shot (Thigh-up) showcasing the figure
- Composition:
  - Angle: Eye level
  - Pose Dynamic: Leaning forward slightly towards the lens
  - Framing: Full body from the waist up
- Action:
  - Stance: Standing straight on with relaxed arms at sides
  - Expression: Direct gaze with an alluring, confident pout
  - Mood: Empowered, sexy, and assertive

[PANEL 3: Bottom-Left (3) - Full Body (Seated)]
- Shot Type: Full Body (Seated) capturing a dynamic pose
- Composition:
  - Angle: Side profile
  - Framing: Subject compacted on the floor, occupying minimal space
- Action:
  - Pose: Knees to chest in a fetal position variation
  - Interaction: Cheek resting on knee, arms embracing legs
  - Hair Flow: Cascading onto the floor in a soft, natural manner
  - Mood: Contemplative, reflective, and slightly melancholic

[PANEL 4: Bottom-Right (4) - Beauty Portrait (Head & Hands)]
- Shot Type: Beauty Portrait (Head & Hands) focusing on the face and hands
- Composition:
  - Angle: Frontal close-up
  - Framing: Chin to hairline, cropped tight
- Action:
  - Gesture: Chin resting on interlaced fingers with relaxed hands
  - Expression: Soft smile, looking off-camera with a dreamy gaze
  - Mood: Whimsical, thoughtful, and slightly nostalgic

[GENERAL DIRECTIONS]
- Ensure the subject appears comfortable and natural in the poses
- Maintain a consistent skin tone and complexion throughout
- Use the lighting rig to create dramatic highlights and shadows
- Pay close attention to details such as texture, tactility, and moisture
- Maintain a seamless, distraction-free background

[OUTPUT FORMAT]
- Provide individual renders for each panel in 4096x5120 PNG format
- Include a composite mockup of the 2x2 grid in 8192x10872 PNG format
- Provide a mood board or reference images for color and texture inspiration

[DELIVERY]
- File names should follow the convention: [YourInitials]_Panel[Number]_[ShotType].png
- Submit all files via the designated cloud folder by [Deadline]
- Include a short description of the creative intent for each image

[NOTE]
- The subject is fictional and may not exist; create a virtual character accordingly
- The scene is a studio environment; avoid any external elements or distractions
- Maintain the highest level of artistic integrity and consistency throughout the project

[END OF PROJECT DIRECTION]
